author: TeIq
content: APPROVE verdict from architect audit. Build/clippy/tests clean (28 lib tests). New regression guards: get_json_retries_once_on_transport_error_then_succeeds + per_request_retries_is_exactly_one. Live evidence: subagent observed 4/5 success during a single-blip window; my probe 6min later showed 5/5 fail during a sustained outage with degraded-cache path serving 478 cached blobs cleanly. Both arms of the retry loop are firing in production logs.
